title: macOS workbench information architecture simplification
goal: Simplify the native app workbench information architecture by separating Control Room/Home from workflow sections, merging overlapping pages, and reducing text-heavy surfaces into icon/tooltip/detail-on-demand patterns while preserving evidence-first migration safety.

last_check_commands.command: swift run --package-path macos SuperMoverApp launch smoke, terminated after it stayed running for 4s

history.detail: Recorded IA diagnosis, three design drafts, recommended direction, acceptance criteria, and implementation tasks.
Added artifacts/workbench-ia-design-board.html with three IA visual drafts and a recommended hybrid direction.
Rendered artifacts/workbench-ia-design-board.png at 1920px desktop width after checking layout for overlap.
User judged the initial design board worse than the implemented app; retained it only as IA exploration, not as visual target.
Added artifacts/workbench-ia-current-language.html/png as the corrected high-fidelity direction based on the existing SwiftUI visual system.
Implemented Home-separated grouped navigation and owner-page routing in ContentView/SidebarNavigation; WorkbenchNavigationTests cover taxonomy and merged internal pages.
Changed sidebar non-available labels to icon+hover help and shortened owner mode strip text without hiding blocking safety text.
Completed grouped Home/Workflow/Evidence/System navigation, owner-page routing, low-density status reduction, model tests, build, diff check, and app launch smoke.
